verdict: Organic visibility dropped sharply this week; foundational work is in motion.
narrative: Across all three entities — Forte Metals, Advance Grinding, and O'Hare Precision — Google Business Profile activity fell between 84% and 92% over the last seven days compared to the prior seven, with search clicks down 45–64% over the same span. No paid campaigns are running, so organic search and profile listings are currently the only active lead channels, making this visibility pullback the primary story this period. The combined 28-day window still produced 329 total profile actions (14 calls, 201 direction requests, 114 web clicks) across all three brands, which gives a baseline to measure recovery against. Web and SEO root-cause work is underway to address the visibility decline, and two underperforming O'Hare listings that generated zero calls despite 358 combined impressions are being reviewed for listing fixes now. Next period, the focus is restoring profile impressions and clearing the foundational milestones that unlock outreach and CRM automation.
